[EN] Wendigos aren't brutes, not by a long shot. They command magic as we do, that's what makes them so dangerous.

I want you to hunt down their {@LinkCreature:34#510#wendigo frostweavers} and {@LinkCreature:34#500#frostmages}, and collect their foci.
[ES] Los wendigos no son brutos, ni mucho menos. Dominan la magia como nosotros, eso es lo que los hace tan peligrosos.

Quiero que caces a sus {@LinkCreature:34#510#wendigo frostweavers} y {@LinkCreature:34#500#frostmages}, y recojas sus focos.

[EN] Splendid. Without their foci, the wendigos magical might is greatly diminished, as is their threat.
[ES] Espléndido. Sin sus focos, el poder mágico de los wendigos disminuye enormemente, al igual que su amenaza.

[EN] It isn't enough to kill wendigos if you leave the foci around to be used by a different wendigo.

Kill the frostmages and frostweavers and collect their magical foci.
[ES] No basta con matar wendigos si dejas los focos por ahí para que los use otro wendigo.

Mata a los frostmages y frostweavers y recoge sus focos mágicos.
